verdict.rationale: The Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data. It offers extracted content, query-relevant page snippets, and a `max_results` count control, and the docs position it for your own downstream processing and agent tool calls, which covers the core of feeding ranked results into a RAG pipeline. Sizing is only evidenced through result count and snippet/extraction controls, not explicit context-budget tuning. Missing for 10: documented per-result or total token/character budget controls for LLM context windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG-readiness and ranking quality.
